defect.source: existing per-tab SSE delivery and polling only when browser already knows about working tabs

defect.reproduction: Open three idle tabs, prompt fixture mobile blocker against a nonforeground tab through the real API, wait one second; observe Idle. Refresh metadata to reveal it.
